connector.name: Gate402 MCP
connector.registryDescription: Pay-per-call agent APIs over x402: web scraping, token compression, and semantic cache.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package gate402-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the pgalyen1987 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: GATE402_API_KEY
env.description: Optional. A funded Gate402 account key to skip the free tier.

env.name: GATE402_BASE_URL
env.description: Optional. Override the gateway base URL (default https://gate402.app).
